title: test_chart_decompose marks its rows as testing and leaves none in the live cairn tables
intention: test_chart_decompose.py folds a per-run id marked as testing into every row it writes to the live cairn tables, and removes that run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block, so a run leaves no row behind and two copies at once do not collide.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 315 nodes and 315 embeddings from this proof's runs stand in the live cairn_nodes and cairn_embeddings, none marked as testing, because its scratch nexus drops only the leaf table. Proof rows in the live corpus are indistinguishable from real ones to every reader of the trees.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: a proof's rows in the live corpus are measurements of nothing, read as real); Law 9 (green is earned: a proof that leaves residue is not clean green).
how: A hypothesis, not a settled shape, the same as 784eb1e92866's: test live but marked as testing. In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/proofs/test_chart_decompose.py a run id (secrets.token_hex, or CAIRN_CODEMOTHER_TRIALS_RUN_ID when set) is folded into every fixture's content, so node_id_for(content) is unique per run, and into each row's provenance as a testing marker. A finally block removes this run's nodes, embeddings and links: trees.forget_leaf over every scratch leaf the run holds (decompose) before the leaf drops, then a delete by the run id for anything forget_leaf could not reach. A scratch table set was weighed and set aside: it would stop the proof measuring the live schema. The new proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/proofs/test_chart_decompose_runs_alongside_itself.py runs two copies of test_chart_decompose.py at once and counts rows before and after; it declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S above the two-copy wall.

clauses.claim: two copies of test_chart_decompose.py run at the same time, both exit 0 with no FAIL tooth
after a run, no row carrying that run's id remains in cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings or cairn_links, and the three tables' counts equal their counts before the run
one copy of test_chart_decompose.py run alone still exits 0

decisions.text: D1: test_chart_decompose.py folds a per-run id and a testing marker into every row it writes and removes this run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block.
D2: the red-first proof runs two copies at once and counts rows before and after, one tooth per clause.

out: the 315 rows already in the tables (not deleted or attributed here)
the other codemother proofs and test_librarian_trees.py (their own tickets)

measured.saw: Read-only SELECT on the live cairn db (akiendelllinux): 315 rows in cairn_nodes with provenance under a chart_decompose_proof_ scratch dir (145 since 2026-10-03), latest 2026-11-19 22:42; content prefix 'split the alpha work' counts the same 315; the same count in cairn_embeddings; 0 carry any testing marker in provenance. Each content ends '[<nexus>]', the run's scratch nexus name, so runs do not collide, but every run's rows stay.
measured.how: SELECT count(*), max(created) FROM cairn_nodes / cairn_embeddings WHERE provenance LIKE '%chart_decompose_proof_%' (and by content prefix), on a read-only session; nothing run against live

measured.saw: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/proofs/test_chart_decompose.py line 348: trees.deposit writes the node to cairn_nodes and the embedding to cairn_embeddings, shared and live, and only the leaf to the run's scratch nexus (decompose, via tree.scratch_nexus). scratch_nexus drops only the leaf table at exit, and the proof never calls trees.forget_leaf.
measured.how: reading cairn/devices/codemother/machines/decompose/proofs/test_chart_decompose.py, cairn/devices/librarian/tools/trees/trees.py (deposit, forget_leaf, scratch_leaf) and cairn/tools/tree/tree.py (scratch_nexus) on cairn main
